issues.message: presents 的常规复数义是“多份礼物”，不能解释为“多个现在场合”；presenting 直接加 -ing，present 没有需要去掉的词尾 e。
present 直接加 -ence 或只去掉 t 再加 -ence，都拼不出 presence。应说明 -ent 与 -ence 的拼写对应，并撤去全部词族成员都直接由 present 派生的断言。
遗漏了主持节目、物质存在、带来问题或机会等常用义，以及英语学习中常见的现在时用法，需分别补充对应词性、例句和搭配。
把介绍人物混入普通展示义，却没有对应例句，也没有说明正式或旧式语体限制。应将人物介绍单列为拓展义，日常介绍人优先用 introduce。
be present 是表语用法，不是后置修饰；the people present 才是后置修饰。
get a present for someone 表示给某人买到或弄到礼物，不是自己收到礼物；原译“给某人……得到”含混。
a present for someone 仍然是礼物表达，不构成反向表达；此处应留空并明确没有通用反义词。
古法语阶段的 meaning 只是来源关系占位；英语阶段“发展出”也无据指定了义项产生的阶段。应把可证实的名词／形容词与动词分支写入 summary，取消这条阶段箭头，并准确写作古法语 presenter。
牛津条目没有提供正文，剑桥条目读取失败，不能承担本次审校的具体材料依据。应改引实际取得的维基词典英语词条；仅依专业语言知识补充的内容不虚挂来源。
删去面向制作过程的“旧音标”说明，并明确重音帮助区分名词／形容词与动词，具体义项仍须看语境。
presently 也常表示“目前”，尤其在美式英语中；不宜只突出“很快”而弱化这一常见用法。

review.coverageAssessment: 已核对材料中的全部英语释义，并逐句检查原有例句、搭配、拼写、读音和 senseId。补丁补齐主持、物质存在、带来问题／机会及语法用法；各核心义均有两个例句，正式或旧式的人物介绍单列拓展。未扩展银行、军事、医学等专门用法；未提供正文或读取失败的网页不作本次直接依据。

the present 与 at present 均有自然例句，保留。
补入语法名词用法及两个例句，与一般时间名词区分。

原有两个例句及 present at／absent from 对照正确，保留。
补入物质、成分等存在于某处的常用义，避免只理解成人员出席。
补入 present tense、present forms 等语法用法，并说明现在时不只表示此刻。
两个例句分别覆盖 present someone with something 和 present something to someone，保留。

senseInventory.assessment: 原有两个例句自然；移出人物介绍后，标题、释义与例句一致。

{"id":"present-adj-existing","title":"存在于某处的（形容词）","meaning":"某种物质、成分或其他事物在某处存在。","usageNote":"常用 be present in + 地点或物体；主语可以是物质或成分，这时不是说人出席活动。","examples":[{"id":"present-adj-existing-ex1","senseId":"present-adj-existing","en":"Vitamin C is present in oranges.","zh":"橙子中含有维生素 C。","note":"present in 表示某种成分存在于某物中。"},{"id":"present-adj-existing-ex2","senseId":"present-adj-existing","en":"The test showed that bacteria were present in the water.","zh":"检测表明水中存在细菌。","note":"were present 表示检测所发现的存在状态。"}],"patterns":[{"en":"something is present in something","zh":"某物存在于某物中","note":"前面说存在的成分，in 后说它所在的地方或物体。","kind":"sentence-pattern"}],"collocations":[{"en":"be present in food/water","zh":"存在于食物／水中","note":"常用于说明成分或物质是否存在。","kind":"common-collocation"}],"relatedExpressions":{"similar":[{"en":"be found in","zh":"存在于；可在……中找到","note":"说明某种成分的分布时，常与 be present in 接近；也可强调实际发现。"}],"contrasting":[{"en":"be absent from","zh":"不存在于；不含于","note":"谈某种成分是否存在时，可与 be present in 对照。"}],"similarNote":"这里比较的是物质或成分的存在状态，不是人员出席。","contrastingNote":"absent 不只表示人缺席，也能表示某种成分不存在；注意 present in 与 absent from 的介词。"},"sourceIds":[]}

{"id":"present-v-cause","title":"带来；造成（问题、机会等，动词）","meaning":"使人面临某个问题或挑战，或给人提供某种机会。","usageNote":"常接 problem、challenge、opportunity 等抽象名词；present someone with something 在这里表示使某人面临某种情况。","examples":[{"id":"present-v-cause-ex1","senseId":"present-v-cause","en":"The broken lift presents a problem for my grandmother.","zh":"坏掉的电梯给我奶奶带来了麻烦。","note":"present a problem 表示造成问题，不是把问题展示出来。"},{"id":"present-v-cause-ex2","senseId":"present-v-cause","en":"The exchange programme presents a good opportunity to practise English.","zh":"这个交换项目提供了一个练习英语的好机会。","note":"present an opportunity 表示带来或提供机会。"}],"patterns":[{"en":"present someone with a problem/an opportunity","zh":"使某人面临问题／给某人带来机会","note":"句型与赠送义相同，但这里的宾语是抽象的问题或机会。","kind":"sentence-pattern"}],"collocations":[{"en":"present a problem/challenge","zh":"造成问题／带来挑战","note":"强调某种情况使人需要应对困难。","kind":"common-collocation"},{"en":"present an opportunity","zh":"提供机会","note":"强调某种情况带来了有利条件。","kind":"common-collocation"}],"relatedExpressions":{"similar":[{"en":"pose a problem","zh":"造成问题","note":"与 present a problem 接近，限于问题或困难等语境。"},{"en":"offer an opportunity","zh":"提供机会","note":"与 present an opportunity 接近，不表示造成困难。"}],"contrasting":[{"en":"solve a problem","zh":"解决问题","note":"谈问题时，解决问题可与造成问题形成情境对照；不适用于机会义。"}],"similarNote":"问题语境可比较 pose，机会语境可比较 offer，不能跨语境整词替换。","contrastingNote":"solve a problem 只是问题语境中的反向行为，不是 present 所有义项的反义词。"},"sourceIds":[]}

{"id":"present-v-host","title":"主持电视或广播节目（动词）","meaning":"担任电视或广播节目的主持人，向观众或听众介绍节目内容。","usageNote":"这一用法在英式英语中常见；美式英语通常更常用 host。与展示一个项目或报告的用法区分。","examples":[{"id":"present-v-host-ex1","senseId":"present-v-host","en":"My sister presents the school radio show on Fridays.","zh":"我姐姐每周五主持学校的广播节目。","note":"presents a radio show 表示主持广播节目。"},{"id":"present-v-host-ex2","senseId":"present-v-host","en":"He presents a cooking programme on local TV.","zh":"他在当地电视台主持一档烹饪节目。","note":"这里的 present 是主持节目，不是赠送节目。"}],"patterns":[],"collocations":[{"en":"present a TV/radio programme","zh":"主持电视／广播节目","note":"节目作 present 的直接宾语。","kind":"common-collocation"},{"en":"present the news","zh":"主持新闻节目；播报新闻","note":"用于新闻主持人的工作。","kind":"common-collocation"}],"relatedExpressions":{"similar":[{"en":"host a programme/show","zh":"主持节目","note":"在节目主持语境中与 present 接近，尤其常见于美式英语；host 还可用于主持活动或招待客人。"}],"contrasting":[],"similarNote":"这里比较的是担任节目主持人的工作；host 的其他含义不能都换成 present。","contrastingNote":"主持节目没有固定的词汇反义词。"},"sourceIds":["wiktionary-present"]}

{"id":"present-n-tense","title":"现在时（名词，语法用语）","meaning":"语法中的现在时名称，如 the simple present（一般现在时）。","usageNote":"常用 the present 或 the simple present；这里指时态，不是泛指现在这个时间。现在时形式也可表示习惯、规律或安排。","examples":[{"id":"present-n-tense-ex1","senseId":"present-n-tense","en":"In 'She walks to school', 'walks' is in the simple present.","zh":"在 She walks to school 这句话中，walks 用的是一般现在时。","note":"the simple present 是一般现在时的名称。"},{"id":"present-n-tense-ex2","senseId":"present-n-tense","en":"Change the verb from the past to the present.","zh":"把这个动词由过去时改成现在时。","note":"the past 和 the present 在这里都是时态名称。"}],"patterns":[{"en":"put a verb into the present","zh":"把动词改成现在时","note":"常见于语法练习指令。","kind":"sentence-pattern"}],"collocations":[{"en":"the simple present","zh":"一般现在时","note":"也称 the present simple。","kind":"common-collocation"},{"en":"in the present","zh":"用现在时","note":"用来说明动词的时态。","kind":"common-collocation"}],"relatedExpressions":{"similar":[{"en":"the present tense","zh":"现在时","note":"指相同的时态概念；这个短语里的 present 是形容词。"}],"contrasting":[{"en":"the past","zh":"过去时","note":"在语法语境中与现在时形成时态对照。"}],"similarNote":"the present 是名词用法，the present tense 则以 tense 为中心名词。","contrastingNote":"这里比较时态类别，不能简单等同于实际事情发生的时间。"},"sourceIds":[]}

{"id":"present-adj-tense","title":"现在时的（形容词，语法用语）","meaning":"用于语法术语，说明时态或动词形式属于现在时。","usageNote":"常放在 tense、form 等名词前。present tense 是时态名称，不能据此认为句子只描述此刻正在发生的事。","examples":[{"id":"present-adj-tense-ex1","senseId":"present-adj-tense","en":"We use the present tense to talk about habits.","zh":"我们用现在时谈论习惯。","note":"present 修饰 tense；一般现在时可以表示经常发生的事。"},{"id":"present-adj-tense-ex2","senseId":"present-adj-tense","en":"The present forms of 'be' are 'am', 'is' and 'are'.","zh":"be 的现在时形式是 am、is 和 are。","note":"这里说的是 be 在一般现在时陈述句中的形式。"}],"patterns":[],"collocations":[{"en":"the present tense","zh":"现在时","note":"present 是修饰 tense 的形容词。","kind":"common-collocation"},{"en":"present forms of a verb","zh":"动词的现在时形式","note":"form 指具体词形，不是事物当前的形状。","kind":"common-collocation"}],"relatedExpressions":{"similar":[],"contrasting":[{"en":"past","zh":"过去时的","note":"修饰 tense 或 form 时，可与 present 构成语法类别上的对照。"}],"similarNote":"这是语法术语，不能用 current 或 modern 替换 present tense 中的 present。","contrastingNote":"present tense 与 past tense 比较的是时态，不是所有句子中事件发生时间的直接对立。"},"sourceIds":[]}

{"id":"present-v-introduce-person","title":"正式介绍某人（动词，较少见）","meaning":"在正式场合把某人介绍给他人。","note":"常见于 May I present ... 或 present someone to someone；语气正式，有时带旧式色彩。日常介绍人通常用 introduce。","example":{"id":"present-v-introduce-person-ex1","senseId":"present-v-introduce-person","en":"May I present our guest speaker, Dr Chen?","zh":"请允许我介绍我们的演讲嘉宾陈博士。","note":"这是正式介绍人物的说法，不是日常介绍人的首选表达。"},"sourceIds":["wiktionary-present"]}
